before: A tag was drawn only for a label with text, so the side of a control a host left undrawn had no slot inside it: typing there landed beside the control.
after: A host can return { variant: 'edge' } for a side: a zero-width tag that paints nothing and has a slot on each side, like any tag.
reason: Tags are view-only: layout and paint read them, nothing is written to the document, the journal or the shared state.
